pages.title: Asymmetric Reactor
pages.text: A cold, stirred vessel where a handed catalyst makes one mirror image of a molecule and not the other.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the reaction temperature and the hydrogen pressure. The selectivity is e^(ΔΔG‡/RT): colder is purer but slower. The product must be at least 90% one hand (ee ≥ 0.9). Fast, but only 60% of runs give the reagent; the Chromatography Column resolves it slowly and surely instead.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Enantiopure Reagent.
